name: Stone throne on a dais
description: A high-backed throne of carved grey stone on a two-step dais 1.4 m square: heavy arms ending in rolled scrolls, a dull red cushion on the seat, a tall back with a framed carved roundel under a pointed gable crest and a ball finial at 2.4 m, flanked by two round columns.

provenance.prompt: A high-backed carved stone throne on a two-step dais, about 1.4 × 1.4 × 2.4 m.
